summary: blockinfile placement and marker options: insertafter or insertbefore a regex (or EOF/BOF), multiline regex support, the marker template with {mark}, and marker_begin.
questions: How do I insert a block right after a specific line?
How do I put a block at the start of a file?
Why does blockinfile insert my block again every run?
Can insertafter match across multiple lines?
How do I change the BEGIN/END words in markers?

answer_card.title: blockinfile placement and markers
answer_card.answer_md:
- `insertafter`: regex (last match) or `EOF` (default if no match)
- `insertbefore`: regex or `BOF`; no match → end of file
- `(?m)` in the regex enables multiline matching (2.14+)
- `marker` (default `# {mark} ANSIBLE MANAGED BLOCK`): must contain `{mark}` and be single-line, or the block gets re-inserted every run
- `marker_begin` (BEGIN) / `marker_end` (END)
